draft.inside_message: Congratulations on opening the third Kettlewell roastery. Three sites in six years is a considerable thing to build, and we were glad to help with the growth funding along the way. Thank you, Harriet, for your trust in us.
draft.sign_off: With our congratulations and best regards,

artwork_brief.style_note: restrained dot grid, brand colours, generous white space

draft.rationale: Formal company-to-company note anchored on the Harrogate opening and the growth from one roastery to three, with a light nod to the 2024 funding work and no mention of fees or services.
